top_signals.title: Trump Says Talks Are Iran’s ‘Last Chance’, Stocks Near Record Highs | The Opening Trade 8/4/2026
top_signals.summary:
Stocks extended gains as investors turned their focus to corporate earnings after weeks of choppy trading spurred by concerns over tech valuations and the conflict in the Middle East.

Iran suggested negotiations with Oman to get more ships moving through the Strait of Hormuz are making progress, but President Donald Trump expressed renewed frustration after calling off what he said was a major attack on the Islamic Republic. 

The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards and Lizzy Burden. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Bessent Says Yen Level Problematic for Japan, Other Currencies
top_signals.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the weakness of the yen has contributed to Japan’s inflation problem and raised the risk of broader depreciation of Asian currencies as he reiterated US support for efforts to stabilize the situation.

top_signals.title: Trump Gives Iran 'Last Chance'; SpaceX, AMD Earnings Ahead | Bloomberg Brief 08/04/2026
top_signals.summary: US equity futures hover near a record high amid a tech-led rally. President Trump says his latest offer of talks is Iran's last chance to make a deal with the US. SpaceX is set to report its first earnings since going public. Cayla Seder of State Street discusses the Fed's credibility challenge and the earnings outlook.  (Source: Bloomberg)
